## PART II

# Scrape a Table (2.1)

table_url <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Community_areas_of_Chicago"

table_page <- read_html(table_url)

# COMMUNITY AREA AND TOTAL POPULATION
wiki_tables <- table_page %>%
  html_elements("table") %>%
  html_table()

population_table <- wiki_tables[[1]]

population_table <- population_table %>%
  setNames(c("area_number", "community_area", "population", "area_sq_mi", "area_sq_km", "density_sq_mi", "density_sq_km")) %>%
  slice(-1) %>%
  filter(area_number != "Total") %>%
  mutate(
    area_number = as.integer(area_number),
    population = parse_number(population)
  )

nrow(population_table)
